note: Fan art — an original drawing of a house from a 1990 film, not affiliated with it. The crayon battle plan in the film was drawn by Macaulay Culkin himself; this one is issued instead: sheet A-101, dated December, 12 rooms, 234.00 m². Red is the way in — back door, kitchen, the foot of the flight. 4 is the ONE hand-written coordinate on the sheet, which is why `arch lint` reports W_SWING_OBSTRUCTED against the front door.
